item.rsinsertexportupgrade.insert_upgrad: Takes resources in specific slots of your inventory and dumps them into your network.
item.rsinsertexportupgrade.export_upgrad: Pulls specific resources from your network into your inventory.
item.rsinsertexportupgrade.block_picker_: Extracts a targeted block from your network when using Pick Block.
item.rsinsertexportupgrade.energy_capaci: Adds %sFE energy capacity to any Wireless Grid.
item.rsinsertexportupgrade.magnet_upgrad: Collects nearby items into your inventory or storage network.
text.autoconfig.rsinsertexportupgrade.op: Number of upgrade slots in any Wireless Grid.
The energy used per operation the Insert Upgrade does.
The energy used per operation the Export Upgrade does.
The energy used when the Block Picker Upgrade extracts a block.
The energy used per successfully collected ground-item stack, including partial pickups.
The pickup radius in blocks. Only visible dropped items are collected.
Extra energy capacity to a Wireless Grid per upgrade.
gui.rsinsertexportupgrade.filter_mode.al: Only items matching the configured filter are inserted.
gui.rsinsertexportupgrade.filter_mode.bl: Items matching the configured filter are excluded from insertion.
gui.rsinsertexportupgrade.magnet.pickup_: Items the magnet may collect from the ground.
gui.rsinsertexportupgrade.magnet.insert_: In Network mode, matching items go to the network; others go to inventory.
gui.rsinsertexportupgrade.magnet.destina: Collected items allowed by the Insert Filter go to the connected Refined Storage network. Other items and network remainders go to your inventory; anything that does not fit stays on the ground.
Collected items go directly to your inventory. The Insert Filter is ignored; anything that does not fit stays on the ground.
Only items matching the Pickup Filter are collected. An empty filter collects nothing. Items and components must match exactly.
Items matching the Pickup Filter are not collected. An empty filter allows all items. Items and components must match exactly.
In Network mode, only items matching the Insert Filter are sent to the network. An empty filter sends nothing to the network. Other items and remainders go to inventory. Items and components must match exactly.

In Network mode, items matching the Insert Filter are excluded from the network. An empty filter allows all items into the network. Excluded items and remainders go to inventory. Items and components must match exactly.
